brief: Today's posts were dominated by the #standwithjensen campaign, which drew the most engagement across Garry Tan, Amjad Masad and Guillermo Rauch. Beyond it, builders discussed model choice for coding, with Garry Tan reporting that Opus 5.5 stayed the better-value default over Fable 5.2 in Claude Code.

themes.label: #standwithjensen campaign
themes.summary: Builders backed a letter and call for due process for Jensen, with Garry Tan, Amjad Masad and Guillermo Rauch sharing it heavily.

themes.label: Opus 5.5 vs Fable 5.2 coding
themes.summary: Garry Tan's eval found Fable 5.2 matched Opus 5.5 on solve rate but cost 2.80x per solved task, while Dan Shipper questioned whether teams still pay for software.

themes.label: Vercel Workflow SDK 5
themes.summary: Guillermo Rauch described Workflow SDK 5 and Vercel Workflows as a major step for agents, with faster steps, stronger security and a reusable durability log.

builders.name: Garry Tan
builders.summary: Posted that Opus 5.5 remains the coding default in Claude Code based on a 52-task eval, and shared his open source harness eval repo. Also signed the #standwithjensen letter.

builders.name: Guillermo Rauch
builders.summary: Called Workflow SDK 5 and Vercel Workflows a monumental step for agents, citing faster steps, security work and a reusable durability log. Also backed #standwithjensen and said Vercel Sandbox is inevitable.

builders.name: Training Data
builders.summary: Published a podcast episode with Ronak from Trajectory on building products for continual learning, centered on putting training, eval and deployment in one place.

builders.name: Nikunj Kothari
builders.summary: Argued that real model use on your own workflows matters more than benchmarks, which he said are often used as marketing. Also noted the FAA ground stop, only the third in modern history.

builders.name: Amjad Masad
builders.summary: Had Replit raise the rate limit on the StandWithJensen page so it could scale, and shared the Stand with Jensen letter. Also said Replit has enjoyed partnering with Visa on agentic commerce.

builders.name: Aditya Agarwal
builders.summary: Congratulated companies on the AI 100 list, including Replit and Baseten. Also said we are in an extremely weird timeline.

builders.name: Peter Yang
builders.summary: Shared a free skill for using ChatGPT or Claude with a loved one's medical records to research clinical trials. Also posted a critique of WSJ reporting on an NVIDIA employee.

builders.name: Dan Shipper
builders.summary: Asked why teams still pay for software when Fable 5.2 can vibe code anything. Also posted a short musing on the most important formula in AI.

builders.name: Swyx
builders.summary: Posted only a brief invitation to a site, saying to come by tomorrow.

builders.name: Matt Turck
builders.summary: Posted a light joke about VCs weighing in on the FAA nationwide ground stop.
